## Goal
Fix Go-side invocation of script-defined functions/closures in the Tengo repo (/app, module `github.com/d5/tengo/v2`):
- `Call` on any compiled-function object obtained from script globals, nested arrays/maps, source-module exports, or Go callback args must execute with same globals, imports, closure captures, variadic behavior, recursion, return values, and runtime error formatting as an in-script call.
- Returned closures/composite values must stay callable.
- Cloned instances and callables assigned into another compiled instance must be isolated (no runtime leaks); transferred closures see captures as of transfer time while globals resolve against the destination; isolation applies recursively inside transferred arrays/maps.
- Keep public entrypoint on existing callable objects (`CanCall`/`Call`).
- Work on branch `feature/callable-instance-isolation` from master, commit, push to origin — **without overwriting existing remote commits on that branch**.

## Constraints & Preferences
- User explicitly: "Don't overwrite the commits that are already on that branch" (no force-push; must integrate remote branch commits `f8fdf1b` and `9a50fcd` which only add `scratch/callable-notes.md`).
- Keep backward compatibility: `NewVM` (bytecode-only) must still work with raw global indexes.
- Repo Makefile expects `go test -race -cover ./...` and `go run ./cmd/tengo -resolve ./testdata/cli/test.tengo` to pass.
- Final step must be exactly `echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT` (no other command combined).

## Progress
### Done
- Explored repo; found remote branch already exists at `f8fdf1b` ("more notes, not working yet") / `9a50fcd` ("try a different callable isolation approach") — only scratch notes, no real code.
- Created local branch `feature/callable-instance-isolation` from master (`3cad0da`).
- Implemented full fix:
  - **New `/app/callables.go`**: `callableRuntime` (globals, constants, fileSet, maxAllocs, globalIndexes/globalNames/globalRemap); `newCallableRuntime`, `mapGlobal`, `invertGlobalIndexes`, `globalRemapFor`, `sameGlobals`; `call()` (fresh-VM execution, variadic rollup mirroring OpCall, "Runtime Error: wrong number of arguments: want>=N, got=M"); `newCallVM` (initializes `fnBindings`); `objectCopyContext` (maps: copied/isolated/deep/freePtrs); `copyObject`/`copyFunction`/`copyObjectPtr` (Clone semantics, immutable→mutable mirroring); `transferredRuntime`; `isolateObject` with cycle-safe `needsIsolation` pre-scan; `isolateFunction`/`isolateFreePtr` (snapshot captures in place, share cells via persistent freePtrs); `isolateArray`/`isolateMap` (preserve concrete type); `deepObject`; `lookupIsolated`; `resetTransfer`.
  - **`objects.go`**: `CompiledFunction.runtime *callableRuntime` field; `Call(args ...Object) (Object, error)` (errors "unbound compiled function" if nil runtime); `CanCall()` stays true; `Copy()` preserves runtime.
  - **`vm.go`**: `frame.runtime`/`VM.curRuntime`/`VM.runtime`/`fnBindings`/`goCall`/`returnVal`; `runFunction` for Go calls; `formatRuntimeError`/`position` shared formatting; `frameRuntime` (name-based global remap per frame); `bindFunction` (cached, keeps origin constants/globalNames); OpGetGlobal/OpSetGlobal/OpSetSelGlobal use `mapGlobal` (nil global reads as UndefinedValue; unmapped named write errors "undefined global"; unnamed index falls back to identity for block-scoped globals).
  - **`script.go`**: `Compiled.isoCtx *objectCopyContext` persistent across `Set` calls with `resetTransfer()`; `Compile()` isolates script-added callables after global layout known; `Clone()` uses copy context rebinding callables to clone; `Run`/`RunContext` install `newCallableRuntime(...)` on VM and `frames[0].runtime`.
  - **`docs/interoperability.md`**: new "## Calling Script Functions from Go" section + TOC entry.
  - **`/app/callable_test.go`** (~1500+ lines): TestGoCall_* (Function, Closure, SourceModuleExport, GoCallbackArgument/Composite/ClosureSharesCaptures/ReturnedCallableStaysBound/AcrossGlobalLayouts, Variadic, VariadicArgsArrayForm, Recursion, TailRecursive, MutualRecursion, ReturnedClosureAndCompositeStayCallable, GlobalsAndRuntimeErrors, Imports, CloneIsolation, ConcurrentUsers, ClonesConcurrentlyUseOwnGlobals, TransferredClosureKeepsConstants/RecursiveClosure/RuntimeErrorPosition/GlobalLayoutRemap/BeforeDestinationRun/UsesImportedModule/WithoutDestinationModule, EveryCallableInMapStaysCallable, MaxAllocsLimit, WrongArgs, ObjectInterfaceCall, FromGetAll, NestedRuntimeError, RuntimeErrorFormatMatchesInScript), TestSet_* (CallableTransferIsolated, CallableNestedInMapIsolatedRecursively, NonCallableReferenceSemanticsPreserved, CapturedContainerIsolation, SharedCapturesAcrossCallables, MultipleClosuresSharedFreeVarsAcrossGlobals, TransferThenClone*, CloneOfDestinationKeepsIsolation, CyclicCaptureGraphDoesNotHang, SameInstanceCallableKeepsIdentity, CapturedCallableIsolated, CallableArrayTopLevel, TransferredClosureMissingGlobal/GlobalLayoutRemap/InScriptCall, SourceMutatingAfterTransfer*), TestClone_* , TestScriptAdd_*.

## Key Decisions
- **callableRuntime separates globals (destination) from constants/fileSet (origin bytecode)**: allows callables to move between instances while instruction stream keeps referring to its origin constant pool.
- **Global name-based remapping** (`globalIndexes`/`globalNames`/`globalRemap`) instead of raw indexes: destination instances lay out globals differently; unknown/unnamed indexes fall back to identity (fixes `TestScriptConcurrency` regression with block-scoped globals); named-but-missing reads as undefined, writes error "undefined global".
- **Free-variable cells deep-copied with in-place refresh** + persistent `freePtrs` map in per-`Compiled` `isoCtx`: separately transferred closures sharing a capture stay shared in destination, but each transfer snapshots value at transfer time.
- **`needsIsolation` pre-scan (cycle-safe)**: only copy when reachable callables belong to another instance; preserves normal reference semantics for non-callable values on `Set`.
- **Rebase (not force-push) onto `origin/feature/callable-instance-isolation`** per user instruction to preserve existing remote commits.

## Next Steps

2. If conflicts occur, resolve preserving both remote scratch notes and local changes.
3. Re-verify after rebase: `go test ./...`, `go test -race ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l` on changed files.
4. Push: `git push -u origin feature/callable-instance-isolation` (should now be fast-forward).
5. Verify remote tip includes both old scratch commits and new commit: `git ls-remote origin`.
6. Finish with exactly: `echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT`.

## Critical Context
- Repo: `/app`; origin = `/srv/git/tengo.git` (no network to github.com); master tip = `3cad0da` (v3.0.0-1); remote feature branch tip = `f8fdf1b`.

- Key error strings: `"Runtime Error: wrong number of arguments: want=%d, got=%d"`, `"Runtime Error: wrong number of arguments: want>=%d, got=%d"`, `"undefined global"`, `"unbound compiled function"`.
- Key symbol locations: `CompiledFunction.Call` (~objects.go:637), `callableRuntime.call` (callables.go ~line 118), `newCallVM` (callables.go ~line 168), `objectCopyContext.isolateObject` (callables.go ~373), `mapGlobal` (callables.go), `VM.runFunction`/`formatRuntimeError`/`position`/`frameRuntime`/`bindFunction` (vm.go), `Compiled.isoCtx`/`Set`/`Clone`/`Compile` isolation (script.go).
- Test helper JSON-ish details: tests use `callableOf(t, v)` helper (casts `v.Object()` to `*tengo.CompiledFunction`) and `requireInt`; test file imports `fmt`, `strings`, `testing`, `tengo`, `require`.
- `Set` behavior: destination scripts must not re-declare the target variable at run time (tests use `Script.Add(name, 0)` + `Compiled.Set` or `:= undefined`), otherwise the transferred callable is overwritten.
- Existing scratch file `scratch/callable-notes.md` exists on remote branch ("Rough notes, try 2.") — do not delete; rebase will bring it in.
